headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 5, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 7-1 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Braxton Ashcraft earning the win after 5.2 innings of work. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with a home run and an RBI. The Minnesota Twins also had a strong outing, defeating the New York Yankees 11-4 behind Josh Bell's three hits, two home runs, and three RBIs. The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Texas Rangers, with Jack Flaherty pitching 5.2 innings of scoreless baseball.

Injuries continue to impact teams across the league. The Milwaukee Brewers placed RHP Brandon Woodruff on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation. The Colorado Rockies also made several roster moves, placing RHP Tomoyuki Sugano and RHP Seth Halvorsen on the 15-day injured list due to back spasms and right shoulder inflammation, respectively. Other teams affected by injuries include the San Francisco Giants, Atlanta Braves, Texas Rangers, Pittsburgh Pirates, and San Diego Padres.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place in the past 24 hours. The Cleveland Guardians acquired RHP Ryan Degges from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for cash. The Washington Nationals made two trades, acquiring LHP Tom Cosgrove from the Houston Astros and RHP Kyle Nicolas from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for cash and SS Randal Diaz, respectively. The Athletics traded 3B Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for RHP Ben Hansen.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Nationals 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 7-1 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Braxton Ashcraft earning the win after 5.2 innings of work. James Wood led the Nationals' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Yankees 11-4**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a convincing 11-4 victory over the New York Yankees, with Josh Bell leading the charge at the plate. Bell's impressive performance included three hits, two home runs, and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Tigers Shut Out Rangers 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Texas Rangers, with Jack Flaherty pitching 5.2 innings of scoreless baseball, striking out 5 batters and allowing just 3 hits. Riley Greene led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Fall to Mariners in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays suffered a 0-11 loss to the Seattle Mariners, marking a tough outing for the visiting team. Randy Arozarena led the Blue Jays' offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Pull Off Thrilling 10-9 Victory Over Braves**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a hard-fought 10-9 win against the Atlanta Braves, marking a comeback victory. Juan Soto and Bo Bichette were among the key contributors for the Mets, while Michael Harris II and Austin Riley led the Braves' offense.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Nationals 11-5**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 11-5 victory over the Washington Nationals, with multiple players contributing to the team's high-scoring performance. Impact hitters for the Pirates included Bryan Reynolds and Nick Gonzales, while the Nationals' Keibert Ruiz also had a notable game.

top_news.title: **Brewers' Brandon Woodruff Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-hander Brandon Woodruff has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation. The move is effective immediately.

top_news.title: **Degges Joins Guardians in Trade**
top_news.summary: Ryan Degges has been traded to the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for cash. The move comes as part of a recent trade involving the Guardians.
